svg.text: microgpt nano: what the loop prints vs. what the model knows
1,264 params · 2,000 Adam steps · one name per step, file order · 3 seeds · held-out = names 2001–2200, never trained on
per-step training loss — the loss on ONE name
held-out loss, zoomed — 200 names never trained on, evaluated every 10 steps
band = min–max of 3 seeds, heavy line = median
the loss on ONE name; step k is the same name in every run
names 2001–2200, forward pass only, never trained on
dot = the loss printed at that step; dashed line = its checkpoint
10 samples, T = 0.5, sampling seed 1234 at each checkpoint
Karpathy’s microgpt at the Fortress nano config: n_embd 8, 2 heads, 1 layer, block 8, first 2,000 names of names.txt in file order, Adam(0.01, 0.85, 0.99) with linear decay.
Validation and checkpoint sampling are additions; they draw from their own RNG and leave the training trajectory bit-identical.
